title: Briefing for 2026-11-16
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-16: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite. AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds. Wholesale prices rose 0.3% in October, putting annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years. UK economy expands 0.7% in third quarter as AI provides 'extra engine of growth'. Analysis: Nvidia’s leadership crisis tests the chipmaker’s role as the ‘central bank of AI’. Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight.
global: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'. Australian MP who lost both legs in alleged car attack discharged from hospital. Prince Harry praises war veterans on surprise visit to Ukraine. South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating. UK will have 'voice' but no vote on EU food rules in Brexit reset. Cut national insurance for under-25s to create jobs, Milburn report to say.
philippines: LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila. ASEAN, China won’t meet 2026 deadline to finish South China Sea talks. Maria Ressa on AI overreliance: ‘Don’t outsource the nuances’. [New Rx] South Korea overcame its IMF crisis. Can Filipinos unite against inflation?.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
